# W3Schools

> > The world's largest web development learning platform offering free tutorials, references, and exercises in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, SQL, Java, PHP, and other programming languages.

W3Schools provides comprehensive web development and programming education through interactive tutorials, code editors, and hands-on exercises. The platform also offers W3Schools Campus for structured courses with certificates and W3Schools Academy for corporate team training.

## Key Topics

- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- Python
- SQL
- React
- Java
- PHP
- Bootstrap
- MySQL
- Web Development
- Frontend Development
- Programming Languages
- Beginner Tutorials
- Interactive Learning

## Core Platform

- [W3Schools Online Web Tutorials](https://www.w3schools.com/): Homepage for W3Schools web development tutorials (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL)
- [Tutorials - Free Web Development and Programming Tutorials](https://www.w3schools.com/tutorials/index.php): Tutorial catalog for web development and programming languages
- [W3Schools Campus](https://campus.w3schools.com/): W3Schools Campus offering coding courses, certificates, and career prep
- [W3Schools Academy](https://www.w3schools.com/academy/index.php): W3Schools Academy for corporate team training and certification programs

## Web Development Tutorials

- [HTML Tutorial](https://www.w3schools.com/html/): HTML markup language tutorial for web development beginners
- [HTML and CSS Tutorial](https://www.w3schools.com/htmlcss/default.asp): Combined HTML and CSS tutorial for frontend web development beginners
- [W3Schools HTML Bootcamp](https://www.w3schools.com/htmL/html_bootcamp.asp): Intensive HTML bootcamp training course from W3Schools
- [HTML Online Editor](https://www.w3schools.com/html/html_editor.asp): Online HTML code editor and learning tool for web development practice

## Programming Languages

- [Python Tutorial](https://www.w3schools.com/python/): Python programming tutorial and beginner's guide from W3Schools
- [Introduction to Programming](https://www.w3schools.com/programming/index.php): Programming introduction and beginner's guide to coding languages

## Optional

- [Certificate of completion from W3schools](https://verify-dev.w3schools.com/): W3Schools certificate verification and credential validation service
